# linear_webhook (Data Source)

Read webhook configuration by UUID. Requires API-management permission. Signing secrets are never queried or returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linear_webhook" "existing" {
  id = "ecb63be7-63fb-47fe-95fc-1585d24e172d"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Exact webhook UUID.

### Read-Only

- `all_public_teams` (Boolean) Whether all public teams are subscribed.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether event delivery is enabled.
- `label` (String) Subscription label.
- `resource_types` (Set of String) Subscribed event resource names.
- `team_id` (String) Subscribed team UUID, when team-scoped.
- `url` (String) Receiver URL. Null for OAuth application webhooks.
